summary: Skye Bioscience filed an 8-K regarding entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with Redmile Biopharma Investments III, L.P. for an equity line of credit (ELOC). The issuer agreed to sell up to $22 million of common and non-voting common shares, reduced by any PIPE proceeds exceeding $103 million. This is a financing arrangement, not a traditional special situation. The filing references a prior Transaction Agreement with Redx Pharma, indicating a broader transaction, but the ELOC itself is a capital-raising mechanism. Watch for drawdowns and dilution; no risk-arb angle.
